approval_evidence.quote: BRIUMVI is a CD20-directed cytolytic antibody ... for intravenous use ... Initial U.S. Approval: 2022

launch_evidence.quote: Product revenue, net for the three months ended March 31, 2023, consisted of net product sales of BRIUMVI in the United States, which was commercially launched in late January 2023

notes: TG Therapeutics' BRIUMVI U.S. net product sales. Where a release prints both a U.S. figure and product revenue including Neuraxpharm (ex-U.S. partner) sales, the U.S. figure is used (e.g. 2026Q1: U.S. 194.8 of 201.3 product revenue, net). The 2023Q2 figure is printed to the whole million ('$16 million') and is recorded at that precision.
search_log: Bigdata.com search located TG Therapeutics' quarterly results; each quarter from its own EX-99.1 of the Item 2.02 8-K (data.sec.gov submissions for CIK 0001001316; accessions listed in the staged rows).

Scope check: 2023Q3 release states '$25.1 million in BRIUMVI net sales in the U.S.' next to total product revenue of $48.9 million (incl. Neuraxpharm sales); 2023Q4 states 'net product sales of BRIUMVI in the U.S. of $39.9 million'; the U.S. line was used throughout.
Launch: 2023-05-01 release, 'commercially launched in late January 2023'; approval letter label 761238s000lbl.pdf 'Initial U.S. Approval: 2022' (openFDA BLA 761238 original approval 2022-12-28).
Cross-check: 2024 quarters 50.5+72.6+83.3+103.6 = 310.0; not compared to a printed full year in this batch (the FY2024 10-K was not opened).
Not used: 'total net revenue' and 'license, milestone, royalty' lines; Neuraxpharm sales were not added to the U.S. line.
